definitions.explanation: A secondary field of study at a university, pursued alongside one's main major. The Japanese university equivalent of an academic minor.

examples.japanese: {副専攻|ふくせんこう}は{心理学|しんりがく}です。
{経済学|けいざいがく}を{副専攻|ふくせんこう}に{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose economics as my minor.

examples.japanese: うちの{大学|だいがく}では{主専攻|しゅせんこう}と{副専攻|ふくせんこう}の{両方|りょうほう}の{単位|たんい}を{取|と}らないと{卒業|そつぎょう}できない。
examples.english: At my university, you can't graduate without completing credits in both your major and your minor.

notes:
Composed of {副|ふく} (sub-, secondary) + {専攻|せんこう} (major, specialization). Not all Japanese universities use this system; some use the term {副専攻|ふくせんこう} while others call it サブメジャー or {副|ふく}プログラム.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副専攻|ふくせんこう}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose a minor
- {副専攻|ふくせんこう}の{科目|かもく}: minor courses
- {副専攻|ふくせんこう}を{取|と}る: to take a minor
- {副専攻|ふくせんこう}{制度|せいど}: minor system/program

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {専攻|せんこう}: major, specialization — the primary field of study
- {主専攻|しゅせんこう}: main major — used explicitly when contrasting with the minor
- {副|ふく}プログラム: sub-program — alternative term used at some universities
